title: Uniform original signed-bank bound in all admissible characteristics
accepted_scope: N odd, d >= 4, N >= 8d-10, m=N-d; a field with a supplied primitive Nth root and characteristic not dividing N. At most 2m+2 original signed banks over a genuine splitting field. Choosing d=floor((N+10)/8) inherits 7N/4+O(1) for odd N >= 23, now in every admissible positive characteristic including two.
finite_field_scope: For q in F_Q, coefficients can be chosen in F_(Q^2). The true splitting-field degree is at most m! over the coefficient field and at most 2m! over F_Q. The coefficient field is not asserted to split the roots.
preparation: Explicit potentially enormous coefficient selection, field construction and root recovery are charged, not reported as completed computations.
warm_cost: For B=2m+2 physical banks: 2BN^2 multiplications and 2BN^2-BN-N additions after paid preparation, including every output and accumulation. Cubic extension-field arithmetic, not an FFT improvement.
retained_owner_status: Broader signed-bank obligations remain open; no owner is closed by this bounded field-scope extension.
limits: No base-field attainment, optimality, smaller bank constant, polynomial extension-degree guarantee or historical-novelty claim.
No full support classification or new N13 extension-degree claim.
